title: Sada Hassan ki Thi Maidaa Me Jayiye Qasim
body:
Sada Hassan ki thi maidan mein jaiye Qasim
Palat key khaime mein wapis na aaiye Qasim
<<MINI>>
Janab-e-Fatima zehra ko muh dekhana hai…..
Janab-e-Fatima zehra ko muh dekhana hai…..
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye kehke gham zada maa ko manaiye Qasim
<<MINI>>
Hasan key laal ho damad-e-sibt-e-paighambar…..
Hasan key laal ho damad-e-sibt-e-paighambar…..
<<DIVIDER>>
Vaegha mein ghazi key tevar dekhaiye Qasim
<<MINI>>
Haazar jaan-e-fida jaan-e-ibne haider par…..
Haazar jaan-e-fida jaan-e-ibne haider par…..
<<DIVIDER>>
Imam-e-waqt pe jaan ko lutaiye Qasim
<<MINI>>
Hujume fouj mein paamal hona jaao kahin…...
Hujume fouj mein paamal hona jaao kahin…...
<<DIVIDER>>
Madad key waste sheh ko bulaiye Qasim
<<MINI>>
Hussain charsu mein maqtal mein de rahe the sada…..
Hussain charsu mein maqtal mein de rahe the sada…..
<<DIVIDER>>
Bas ek baar sada phir sunaiye Qasim
<<MINI>>
Dikhane ghamzada maadar ko chandi si surat…..
Dikhane ghamzada maadar ko chandi si surat…..
<<DIVIDER>>
Lahu key chehre se sehra hataaiye Qasim
<<MINI>>
Pisar ki laash pe maadar key bain the Mazhar…..
Pisar ki laash pe maadar key bain the Mazhar…..
<<DIVIDER>>
Jinan mein dadi ki qidmath mein jaaiye Qasim
